findings.distinction: Fresh legacy replay and original validation/identity commitments retain different scope.
findings.blockedClaim: Old plan had explicit missing RunIdentity fields or replay constitutes new test/build/cohort coverage.
findings.reopen: Future historical verification must preserve actual fields and separately label derived runtime identities.

findings.distinction: Candidate access,active reasons and actual choice differ across scoped neutral policies.
findings.blockedClaim: NoActiveReasons is chosen idle or candidate-history contrast alone proves action influence.
findings.reopen: New option-set or neutral policy requires admitted contract and actual-choice comparison.

findings.distinction: Expectation-mediated reinforcement is not isolated habit effect or objective reward escalation.
findings.blockedClaim: Withheld receipts isolate history only or rising means guarantee monotonic action frequency.
findings.reopen: General reinforcement claims need independent interventions and all-seed distribution/action evidence.
